row.title: Seed D1 route failed on a duplicate column the Worker had already added
row.body: site/deployer.js seedD1 now reruns a file statement by statement and skips only a duplicate ADD COLUMN, matching migrate.js and apply-d1-migrations.mjs. A failed seed migration is already a row the seed-live detector files.
